# apple_app_store_version (Resource)

Manages an App Store version of an app: its version number, release options and build. A platform has one version in preparation at a time, and creating this resource while there is one manages it. Once a version is submitted and approved it can't be edited, so changing it then creates the next version, and destroying the resource deletes the version only if it was never submitted. Submit it with `apple_submit_for_review`. Import it by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_app_store_version" "ios" {
  app_id         = data.apple_app.example.id
  platform       = "IOS"
  version_string = "1.2.0"
  copyright      = "2026 Example Inc."
  release_type   = "MANUAL"
  build_id       = data.apple_build.latest.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the app.
- `platform` (String) Platform: `IOS`, `MAC_OS`, `TV_OS`, `VISION_OS`.
- `version_string` (String) Version number shown on the App Store, e.g. `1.2.0`.

### Optional

- `build_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the build to submit, e.g. `data.apple_build.latest.id`. It must be a valid build of the app for the platform. Removing it leaves the build attached.
- `copyright` (String) Copyright line, e.g. `2026 Example Inc.`
- `earliest_release_date` (String) Release time for a `SCHEDULED` release, in UTC, e.g. `2026-12-01T16:00:00Z`. Removing it leaves the time set.
- `release_type` (String) How the version is released after approval: `MANUAL`, `AFTER_APPROVAL`, `SCHEDULED`. `SCHEDULED` releases it at `earliest_release_date`.
- `review_type` (String) Review type: `APP_STORE`, `NOTARIZATION`. `NOTARIZATION` is for apps distributed outside the App Store in the EU.

### Read-Only

- `created_date` (String) When the version was created.
- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the version.
- `state` (String) State of the version, e.g. `PREPARE_FOR_SUBMISSION` or `READY_FOR_DISTRIBUTION`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_app_store_version.ios
  identity = {
    id = "1234567890"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the version.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apple_app_store_version.ios 1234567890
```
